description.narrative:
The mission of SUMERNET PLUS aims to improve the policies and practices in the Mekong Region to support a just, inclusive and sustainable transition towards enhanced climate resilience in relevant key sectors across different levels (at sub-national, national, and regional levels) through inclusive and solution-oriented knowledge co-production (research), capacity development of researchers, application of innovations and policy engagement, while taking into account gender equality, disability and social inclusion and human rights based approach in the Mekong Region.
The following are the objectives of SUMERNET PLUS:
1. Enhanced capacities and inclusive collaborations of Mekongs knowledge producers, policy influencers, and young professionals are needed to deliver credible research, solution-oriented knowledge co-production, policy engagement, and communications that respond to the differentiated needs of local communities, women and other marginalised groups, and local leaders in addressing climate resilience challenges.
2. Improved policy development and implementation by policymakers and practitioners that are inclusive, gender-responsive and grounded in human rights-based approach to deliver equitable climate resilience solutions in the Mekong Region.
3. Adoption of just, equitable and sustainable practices by the private sector and other stakeholders, based on inclusive evidence from solution-oriented knowledge co-production, will contribute to climate resilience in the Mekong Region.

Det övergripande målet för SUMERNET PLUS är att förbättra policies och riktlinjer i Mekongregionen för att stödja en rättvis, inkluderande och hållbar övergång till ökad motståndskraft mot klimatförändringar i relevanta nyckelsektorer på lokal-, nationell- och regional nivå. Detta skall åstadkommas genom inkluderande, lösningsorienterad och samskapad kunskap (forskning), ökad forskningskapacitet, tillämpning av innovationer och politiskt engagemang i Mekongregionen. Samtidigt skall hänsyn tas till jämställdhet, funktionsnedsättning och social inkludering genom en rättighetsbaserad ansats. För att uppnå detta kommer programmet (SUMERNET PLUS) att öka både kapaciteten och bidra till ett mer inkluderande samarbete mellan kunskapsproducenter, politiska påverkare och unga yrkesverksamma för att leverera lösningsorienterad samskapad ny kunskap. Projektet kommer också bidra till förbättrad utveckling av policyers och dess implementering av beslutsfattare och praktiker på ett inkluderande och evidensbaserat sätt. Slutligen kommer projektet att bidra till att privata sektorn och andra intressenter inför rättvisa, jämlika och hållbara metoder som bidrar till en Mekongregion som är motståndskraftig mot klimatförändringar.
Kärnan i programmet är forskningsanslagen och under programperioden planerar SUMERNET PLUS att ha utlysningar om totalt 34 anslag, som kommer att nå minst 200 forskare i Mekongregionen, med sex olika typer av anslag som utformats efter behov och för att uppnå så stort genomslag som möjligt.

The overall mission of SUMERNET PLUS is to improve the policies and practices in the Mekong Region to support a just, inclusive and sustainable transition towards enhanced climate resilience in relevant key sectors across different levels (at sub-national, national, and regional levels) through inclusive and solution-oriented knowledge co-production (research), research capacity development, application of innovations and policy engagement, while taking into account gender equality, disability and social inclusion and human rights based approach in the Mekong Region. To achieve this SUMERNET PLUS will enhanced capacities and inclusive collaborations of Mekong’s knowledge producers (researchers), policy influencers, and young professionals (including young researchers) that are needed to deliver credible research, solution-oriented knowledge co-production, policy engagement, and communications that respond to the differentiated needs of local communities, women and other marginalised groups, and local leaders in addressing climate resilience challenges. SUMERNET will improved policy development and implementation by policymakers and practitioners that are inclusive, gender-responsive and grounded in human rights-based approach to deliver equitable climate resilience solutions in the Mekong Region. Finally, SUMERNET will contribute to the adoption of just, equitable and sustainable practices by the private sector and other stakeholders, based on inclusive evidence from solution-oriented knowledge co-production, that will contribute to increased climate resilience in the Mekong Region.
At the core of the program is the research grants and over the programme period, SUMERNET PLUS plans to have calls for a total of 34 grants, that will reach at least 200 researchers across the Mekong Region.

No reports have yet been submitted under the current phase of support to SUMERNET.
Draft results for July 2025 to June 2026 include (communicated at Annual Meeting 2026):
• Launched the competitive call for SUMERNET Scoping Studies
• Scoping Study No.2 delivered
• SUMERNET PLUS Grant Amendment No.1• Onboarding programme thematic advisors
• Launched the competitive call and contracted independent evaluation team for Impact Evaluation.
• Launched the competitive call and contracted Rapid Response Grants
12 grants was rewarded in 3 different grant types (Capacity Development, Impact, Innovation). The implementation period is July 2026 June 2027. The impact grants focus on strengthening research, policy and practice for climate resilience impact. The innovation grants focus on piloting and scaling climate-resilient solutions with inclusion of the private sector
• Launched the competitive call and granted 4 SUMERNET fellows
One woman and three men where recruited from Lao DPR (1), Myanmar (2) and Vietnam (1). The remaining two fellow scholarships will be launched during Q3 2026 for 6 month fellowships.
• Organization of SUMERNET 20th Anniversary and SUMERNET-MTT Policy Forum
• Publication of long-term story of change of SUMERNET
• Review of SUMERNET Governance Structure initiated
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
